steps.description:
- Make your way back through the **Calios Mental Hospital** until you reach the torture chair, where you'll find someone in it!
- Talk to **Introverted Chopin** to find out that he is a **Lottery Member**!
- Nothing strange about the ring here.
- Make sure to win the **Eternity Card** here before continuing on; it's the best **Guild Card**, allowing you to get 50% discounts and 25% price rises!
- If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
- Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

notes.title: Note
notes.text:
- We'll be able to pick up an item (the **Air Gravestone**) soon by having **Tissues** on hand, so **purposely** lose on this ring so you can gain a Tissue.
- If you don't want to waste a **Lottery Ticket** to get the **Tissues**, you can get some later on by winning the **Pit Fight** with **Margarete** (once it becomes available), or from the **Buggy** enemies in the **Cave Temple**, as they will drop them.

steps.description: Make your way back to the innermost chamber where you fought **Olga**. Examine the blanket/cloth on the ground on the left side of the room to find a **Deathblade, Jiru** for **Keith**.
That's it for **Calios Mental Hospital**, so off to the next task.
